# Behavior guide template

Copy only the sections needed into a subject-named guide, then register it in the
documentation index. Replace prompts with current behavior; do not fill this template
with a task history. Follow [documentation policy](../DOCUMENTATION.md).

## Purpose and prerequisites

State the reader's task, the supported entry point and required configuration.

## Behavior and boundaries

Describe inputs, outputs, ownership, permissions and limits. Link the authoritative
modules or guides. Distinguish unsupported behavior from an unverified environment.

## Failure and recovery

Explain actionable errors, cancellation, retries, saved-state compatibility and
recovery without losing existing work.

## Verification

Give repeatable commands or manual checks and what each can establish. Keep results,
timestamps, local paths and completed acceptance records outside tracked source.
